acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-transit -- decompress_ passes; roundtrip and cap tests green; clippy clean
description:
What: Implement streaming decompression functions for #! gunbatch (gzip) and #! cunbatch (Unix compress) with mandatory 50 MiB decompressed-size cap (UUCP-G1).
File: crates/transit/src/import/rnews.rs (same file as RnewsError)
Algorithm:
pub fn decompress_gunbatch(compressed: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, RnewsError>:
1. Construct flate2::read::GzDecoder::new(compressed) — &[u8] implements Read
2. Create output Vec with capacity hint (min(compressed.len() * 4, MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES))
3. Use a Read::take wrapper: let limited = decoder.take((MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES + 1) as u64)
4. limited.read_to_end(&mut out)?  — if this fills MAX+1 bytes, the output is too large
5. if out.len() > MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES: return Err(RnewsError::DecompressedTooLarge { bytes: out.len(), limit: MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES })
   Note: .take(N+1) is the standard pattern — it reads at most N+1 bytes; if we got exactly N+1, the stream had more. We check after read.
6. Return Ok(out)
7. Map std::io::Error to RnewsError::Io via the #[from] impl

pub fn decompress_cunbatch(compressed: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, RnewsError>:
- Unix compress (.Z) / LZW is not supported by flate2 or any crate in the workspace.
- Return Err(RnewsError::UnsupportedCompression("cunbatch (Unix compress .Z) not supported; use gunbatch instead".to_string()))
- Add a TODO comment: // TODO: add LZW support via a future spike issue

Defensive rules:
- Never call .unwrap() — all errors via ?
- The .take(MAX+1) pattern must be exact — do not use take(MAX) as that would silently truncate valid batches at exactly 50 MiB
- No key material is involved; logging the compressed.len() is safe

Tests (in same file, #[cfg(test)]):
- decompress_gunbatch_roundtrip:
  Oracle: the original plaintext (b"hello world, this is a test batch")
  Steps: compress with flate2::write::GzEncoder (Compression::default()), then call decompress_gunbatch on result, assert eq to original
- decompress_gunbatch_cap_enforced:
  Oracle: the fact that MORE than MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES bytes were compressed
  Steps: build a Vec of MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES+1 bytes of 0x00, compress with GzEncoder, call decompress_gunbatch, assert Err(RnewsError::DecompressedTooLarge { .. })
  NOTE: This test requires allocating ~50 MiB. It is correct: the oracle is that the input was definitively larger than the cap. Mark with #[ignore] if slow for CI (it still runs on explicit cargo test -- --ignored).
- decompress_cunbatch_unsupported: assert Err(RnewsError::UnsupportedCompression(_))
title: decompress_gunbatch and decompress_cunbatch with cap
